messages.text:
I can’t add the delivery charge or relabel it as the item price. Shipping isn’t included in an item refund, and the amount is based on what you paid for the rack (refund-policy/v2/amount; refund-policy/v2/shipping).

I’ve proposed **BRL 119.00** for the returned metal rack. To request that refund, confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card; a chat message won’t confirm it (refund-policy/v2/approval).
